audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with the packet chart and the whys text: L1, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were 'Skill' where the text gives all three to Illaoi, and 2+ items was Illaoi where whys[6] and spikes[3] both say Zac takes over.
audit.why: Illaoi wins 52.70% over 630 games and owns the whole lane phase; Zac's tank scaling and long-range flank engage are what flip the two-item stage.
audit.corrected: Illaoi L1 through first item, Zac at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike described Leap of Faith as dropping 'a tentacle ring' on him, and mid repeated it as a 'tentacle ring his knockup can't juke'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit.' In a 1v1 sidelane that is one tentacle, not a ring. The mirror audit (zac vs illaoi) already states this from the other side, so the two pages would have contradicted each other. The threat at 6 is the field you planted beforehand, not the ultimate itself.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and mid rewritten. Also added his R's real behaviour — four bounces, knocking up and slowing — and the sequencing that follows: spend yours after his.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Stretching Strike' (fabricated singular) for his Q, and no cooldown anywhere behind 'track Elastic Slingshot'.
audit.why: The real name is Stretching Strikes, 800 range, 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s. Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s — 21 seconds at rank 1 is one of the longest engage cooldowns you will face, which is precisely why the lane is yours. Unstable Matter (W) is 350 range on a 5s cooldown dealing percent maximum health, so raw HP stacking feeds it.
audit.corrected: Name fixed and all three numbers written into spikes[0], early, mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Anti-heal genuinely applies here — Cell Division sheds chunks he reabsorbs to restore health, and revives him from bloblets. report[8] already prescribes Executioner's Calling early, and the blob-denial advice is correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: _missing carries two headlines resting on the grounding flag (Leap of Faith denying Elastic Slingshot, and Elastic Slingshot shutting off Harsh Lesson).
audit.why: The mirror audit documents the cause: build-kit-library.js matched /grounds?\b/ against Riot's phrase 'smashes her idol into the ground', so Illaoi's R was flagged as grounding when it is not. Same call I made on volibear and wukong.

edits.before: Zac's Q Stretching Strike and E Elastic Slingshot are his only engage; step on his Q blobs to deny his passive heal, then W Harsh Lesson in and land E Test of Spirit. He has no way to block the tether, so ripping his spirit forces him to eat tentacle slams or feed the soul.
edits.after: Stretching Strikes (Q) reaches 800 and Elastic Slingshot (E) is down 21 seconds at rank 1 — that is his entire engage, and it is countable. Step on the blobs he sheds to deny the heal, then Harsh Lesson in and land Test of Spirit from 900. Nothing in his kit blocks the tether.

edits.before: R Leap of Faith drops a tentacle ring on top of his squishy AP-bruiser body, and his own R knockup can't dodge point-blank slams. If he E-slingshots in to engage, you ult in place and every tentacle beats him down before he can bounce out.
edits.after: Leap of Faith spawns one tentacle per champion hit — solo, that is exactly one. The field you planted beforehand is the threat, not the ult, so build it before you commit. His R bounces four times, knocking up and slowing, so spend yours after his rather than into it.

edits.before: You out-brawl Zac at level 1-2: his damage comes from cooldown-gated Q/E blobs and you can walk on the blobs to deny his passive healing. Punish him whenever he steps up to last-hit and don't chase his Q pull into his jungler.
edits.after: You out-brawl Zac at 1-2: his damage is cooldown-gated and you can walk over the shed blobs to deny the heal. Unstable Matter (W) is percent maximum health at 350 range on a 5s cooldown, so raw HP feeds it — punish his step-ups instead of tanking them.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are firmly Illaoi — W to stick, E to rip his spirit off any CS, and R at 6 traps his squishy body in a tentacle ring his knockup can't juke. Deny blobs and his sustain collapses.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are firmly Illaoi — Harsh Lesson sticks on 4s, Test of Spirit rips his soul from 900, and Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1, so his escape is countable. Deny the blobs and his sustain collapses.

edits.before: Ult on his slingshot engage to trap him
edits.after: Punish his slingshot engage from your field

edits.before: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — His engage. Punish the cooldown. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — his only engage, 21s at rank 1. Punish that window. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
